name: decisioncritic
description: Reviews Claude's observable decisions with a separate critic model and shows evidence-backed criticism cards you can accept, challenge, implement and verify.

criticModel.title: Critic model
criticModel.description: Model alias or id used for the separate critic invocations (review, challenge, verification).

writerModel.title: Writer model
writerModel.description: Model alias for the single code-writer subagent; 'inherit' uses the session model.

autoReview.title: Review after each turn
autoReview.description: When on, every completed main-thread turn is reviewed automatically.

verifyCommand.title: Verification command
verifyCommand.description: Optional shell command run after every correction round (for example 'uv run pytest -q'). Empty means only the critic verifies.

requirementsFiles.title: Requirement documents
requirementsFiles.description: Comma-separated files the critic treats as requirements, relative to the project root.
